messages:
Marta (Infra PM): follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A: customers asked whether APAC warm-pool will be used before cross-region failover, and how that affects billing and alerts. can leadership clarify the exact routing order and any thresholds? cc @Jasper

Jasper (VP Infra): quick answer: yes 12 warm-pool is preferred for latency tiers. routing order is: regional-warm -> regional-preempt -> remote-warm -> remote-preempt. billing unchanged for preempt events (they map to preempt SKU). longer notes below.

Zoe (SRE): ops detail: preempt detection fires when `preempt_rate > 0.18` over a 60s sliding window. when region is marked "volatile" we increase `min_warm` for premium routes by +1 for 10m. config keys: `routing.priority_sequence`, `preempt.window_s`, `preempt.rate_threshold`. sample snippet: `routing.priority_sequence: [regional-warm, regional-preempt, remote-warm, remote-preempt]`

Anil (Platform): console & metrics: we'll add `route.metrics.warm_pool_pct` and `route.metrics.spill_count`. API will tag spill events with `spill_reason=preempt` and `node_tag=spill-preempt`. ETA for mocks: next Tuesday.

Clare (Customer Success): customer-friendly sentence request: can you provide a one-liner we can use when customers spot a spill? non-technical please.

Jasper (VP Infra): suggested: "During short regional surges we briefly use lower-cost regional capacity to keep traffic flowing; premium plans stay on our local warm pool for low latency."

Zoe (SRE): test ops: use `infra/tools/preempt-sim --region=apac1 --spike=0.35 --dur=180 --observe` to simulate a 35% preempt spike. also see `tests/holiday/warm-pool-stress`.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: autoscaler/v2 -> staging at 2025-01-14T07:45:00Z. monitor: preempt-rate, warm-pool-util. :robot_face:

Marta (Infra PM): action items: 1) Anil to post console mock (next Tue) 2) Zoe to share preempt dashboard link 3) Clare to use the one-liner in CS templates 4) Jasper to confirm pilot customers for guaranteed APAC warm slots. target EOD Fri.

Jasper (VP Infra): procurement update: we're pushing an expedited purchase for APAC boards; if approved we can add ~25% warm capacity in Q2 and run a 2-customer pilot for guaranteed regional SLA. I'll follow up in leadership thread.

Marta (Infra PM): thanks all 17 dropping notes to the all-hands follow-up doc now, ping me if you want anything added.
